These enemies can be the [[Giant Skeleton]] (60% chance) and the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] (40% chance). |ability1_cooldown = 35 |ability2 = '''{{WikiAb|Cloak}}''' - Becomes a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy at half health. }} ==Description== The '''Conjurer''' is an enemy that appears in [[Badlands II]]. It has high health and walks at a slow speed. The '''Conjurer''' has two abilities. The first ability is ''Summon'', which causes it to slam its staff, summoning six random enemies with a 0.5 delay between each spawn. These enemies can be the [[Giant Skeleton]] (60% chance) and the [[Necromancer (Modern Enemy)|Necromancer]] (40% chance). Its second ability, ''Cloak'', only happens when it loses half of its health. This turns it into a [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]] enemy, making it untargetable by towers without hidden detection. ==Appearance== The '''Conjurer''' has light maroon skin. It wears a brown shirt and pants, as well as a light brown scarf, bandages and dark brown gloves. On its head, it wears a grey and light red metal helmet with horns, which resembled a skull. It wears grey and red shoes and padding around its waist. It walks with a staff. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, like the the [[Turret]], [[Pursuit]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Accelerator]] can be useful here. **High DPS towers with splash damage capabilities can be especially useful, as they can hit both the '''Conjurer''' and the enemies it summons. Such towers include the [[Ranger]], [[Pursuit]] and [[Engineer]]. **At half health, the '''Conjurer''' will become [[Hidden (Attribute)|Hidden]], so make sure you have sufficient hidden detection source. ***The [[Ace Pilot]] and [[Firework Technician]] can be used to give towers that do not have hidden detection, such as the [[Ranger]] hidden detection, allowing them to kill it. *Area of effect towers like the [[Mortar]], [[Rocketeer]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be useful at dealing with enemies spawned by the '''Conjurer'''. *No cash can be generated from summoned enemies. This includes the [[Cowboy]]'s cash generation. **However, this also means that the [[Cowboy]] will deal more DPS to the summons, as attacking summoned enemies does not make it spin its guns, making it attack for longer. *The '''Conjurer''' has multiple immunities, meaning it is far harder to slow down. **As it has the [[Freeze Immunity]], it cannot be frozen or chilled by freezing towers. This also means it cannot have its defense dropped through freeze. **Its [[Stun Immunity]] prevents it from being knocked back by towers. It also makes it only get slowed down by stuns instead of fully stunned. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} ConjurerWalk.gif|Walking animation (5 February 2025 – Present) ConjurerSummon.gif|''Summon'' animation (5 February 2025 – Present) ConjurerThrow.gif|Unused spell animation ConjurerDeath.gif|Death animation (5 February 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Conjurer.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseConjurer.png|Current [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, Current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ConjurerIconIG.png|'''Conjurer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''5 February 2025''' - [[v1.52.0]] **'''Conjurer''' added. {{Badlands|[[Cavalry]]|Wave 25|Conjurer|Wave 27|[[Gunslinger]]|Wave 30}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Late-Game]]
